assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness, raising concern for underlying paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The patient has a history of unspecified cardiac arrhythmia.
The patient has a diagnosis of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0).
The patient has a diagnosis of unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9).
A 48-hour Holter monitor (CPT 93226) is ordered to capture potential arrhythmic events.
The payer denied this service under Reason Code PR-204.
The denial indicates the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan.
The clinical indication supports coverage for this cardiac monitoring service.
